title: DebouncingFunctionVisualizer
description: A simple interactive front-end project that demonstrates how a debouncing function works in JavaScript. It lets users click a button repeatedly and visually shows that the actual callback is executed after 500ms of inactivity..

title: HuffmanCompressor
description: A Java-based file compressor and decompressor using Huffman Coding, implemented with Greedy Algorithm, Priority Queue, and Binary Trees — no external libraries required.

title: ShreyFlixAI
description: Full-stack IMDb-inspired movie platform with movie discovery, ratings, reviews, search, and an AI-powered recommendation system for personalized movie suggestions.

title: ThrottleFunctionVisualizer
description: A simple interactive front-end project that demonstrates how a throttling function works in JavaScript. It lets users click a button repeatedly and visually shows that the actual callback is executed at a controlled rate.
